channel.description: Signed Setbeam updates for Apple Silicon Macs.

item.title: Setbeam 0.3.0 build 41
item.description:
Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later. Developer prerelease, signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

Download the Mac app · Installation and setup

Install and update

  • Open the disk image and drag Setbeam to Applications. macOS opens it normally; you no longer need Open Anyway in Privacy & Security.
  • Setbeam checks for signed updates once a day. Choose Setbeam → Check for Updates… to check now, or turn automatic checks off in Settings → Updates. Installing an update quits and reopens the app.
  • An update found while you're sharing waits in the menus and never interrupts the share. If you install one during a share, Setbeam asks before ending it.
  • Build 40 and earlier can't update themselves. Install this build once by hand; later builds arrive in the app.
  • The new signature means macOS asks again for Screen Recording, Camera, Microphone, Local Network and Location access the first time each is needed.

Changes since build 40

Build 41 adds notarized installation and in-app updates. Monitoring, sharing, viewer access and media behavior are unchanged from build 40, including its memory and viewer-approval fixes. See the build 40 notes.

Limits

Hardware compatibility is unchanged. Physical iOS/Safari and keyboard tests, audible native output and A/V timing, long transmitter sessions, physical 4K devices, wider capture hardware, older macOS and Intel support remain separate qualification. See hardware tests.
